title: Được
summary: Different ways to say Được in Vietnam start with accepting a suggestion or saying an option works.

sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Được is the compact okay when a plan works, a suggested option is acceptable, or someone asks whether something is possible. It is not just yes; it often means can, okay, allowed, or that works in context.

sections.title: The standard way
sections.body: Use Được when you want to accept a practical option without adding a long sentence.

sections.title: Break it down
sections.body: Think of it as permission, possibility, and acceptance packed into one short word.

sections.title: Nearby answers
sections.body: Use these when the answer is yes, correct, or no instead of accepted.

sections.title: When to use it
sections.body: Use it when a driver suggests a drop-off spot, a staff member offers an option, a seller asks whether a size works, or someone checks whether a plan is okay.

sections.title: Good to know
sections.body: Dạ được is a warmer version in respectful moments, but Được alone is useful when the exchange is moving quickly.

sections.title: Explore next
sections.body: These are common next moves after accepting an option.
